title: JLA: Book One — DC Comics Grant Morrison, Mark Millar, Howard Porter, Ariel
descriptionText:
Condition: Excellent — very light shelf wear, tight binding, clean pages (see photos).
Description:
The legendary Justice League of America saga returns! This JLA: Book One trade paperback collects the complete early run of Grant Morrison’s iconic relaunch of the Justice League — featuring Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, The Flash, Aquaman, Green Lantern, and Martian Manhunter as Earth’s greatest heroes.
This comprehensive volume also includes companion stories, annuals, and one-shots — making it the definitive starting point for one of DC Comics’ most acclaimed superhero series.
Details:
Title: JLA: Book One
Publisher: DC Comics
Writers: Grant Morrison, Mark Millar, Brian Augustyn, Tom Peyer, Keith Giffen, and others
Artists: Howard Porter, Ariel Olivetti, Val Semeiks, Gene Ha, Yanick Paquette, and more
Cover Artist: Howard Porter, John Dell, and Pat Garrahy
Collection Cover Artist: Frank Quitely
ISBN: 978-1-77952-567-3
Format: Trade Paperback
Publication Year: 2023
Retail Price: $49.99 USD / $65.99 CAD
Contents:
JLA #1–9
JLA: Secret Files & Origins #1
JLA/WildC.A.T.s #1
JLA: Tomorrow Woman #1
JLA 80-Page Giant #1
JLA Annual #1
JLA: Paradise Lost #1–3
JLA Gallery
Condition Notes: Excellent overall. Slight bending near spine from storage, no tears or writing (see close-up photos).
